title: MultiMeters — pet merge correctness, roster perf and dead code
cluster_summary: Every finding is confirmed and every fix belongs in MultiMeters. The one real defect is MM-R-01: with Merge pets on, the owner's own-source setCell overwrites a cell that foldPet created earlier, so a pet that ranks above its owner loses its numbers. Fix it together with its red-first test MM-R-02 in a single commit. MM-A-08 does not route upstream: the conformance step 8 RightButton drive is a per-addon test, the menu mock is addon-local, and the other 10 addons already drive RightButton in tests/test_disabled.lua. MultiMeters is the only one that does not, so the fix is local. MM-R-03, MM-R-04 and MM-R-08 are cheap fixes worth doing. MM-R-06 is optional tidying.

verdicts.assessment: The figures are silently wrong whenever the pet comes before its owner in a column with Merge pets on, and the wrong value flows into total, rate, percent and /mm export. Both lenses agree.
verdicts.remediation: In placeSource's own-source path, add to a cell that foldPet already created instead of replacing it, under the same Secrets.CanCompare2 and type guards foldPet uses. Land the MM-R-02 red-first test in the same commit (subject 'MM-R-01 + MM-R-02: ...'). Split placeSource if it would go above CCN 15.

verdicts.assessment: This test gap is why MM-R-01 shipped green. It is the red-first test the fix needs anyway, so it is not separate work.
verdicts.remediation: Add a new case in tests/test_aggregator.lua with order PET 400 -> BETA 200 -> ALPHA 100 and mergePets on. Assert ALPHA DamageDone.total == 500 and the folded rate. Leave the existing order-only case at :341 unchanged. Commit it with MM-R-01, then regenerate docs/test-cases.md and the README badge with the generator.

verdicts.assessment: ensure() rebuilds a partial roster on every lookup (60 UnitGUID calls against 3 per build, every 0.25s), and a roster can stay partial for a long time. The comments claim the opposite, which misleads anyone reading the code. The cost is small, but the fix is cheap.
verdicts.remediation: Rebuild a partial roster at most once per aggregate pass (for example, rebuild through Roster.GetGroup() at the start of the pass and answer every other lookup from cache). Correct the comments at Roster.lua:405 and :535. Add a unit test that counts rebuilds or UnitGUID calls during one partial-roster Build. The rosterPartial perf scenario and the docs/performance.md figures are optional.

verdicts.assessment: The player sees a wrong result: renaming 'Raid' to 'raid' stores 'raid 2'. The fix is one line and a test.
verdicts.remediation: In WindowManager:Rename/uniqueName, leave the window being renamed out of the collision check so a case-only rename keeps the new name. Add a test for Raid -> raid.

verdicts.assessment: This is dead machinery for the retired Back button. It still runs on every render, and three tests make the coverage inventory overstate what is live. Removing it is cheap and low-risk.
verdicts.remediation: Remove AcquireBackButton/ReleaseBackButton, the backButtons table and its lookups in Exit/ExitAll, BACK_BUTTON_WIDTH/HEIGHT, the Window.lua:1296-1297 call and the three tests in tests/test_drilldown.lua. Update docs/module-map.md where it lists these methods. Regenerate docs/test-cases.md and the README badge with the generator.

verdicts.assessment: The gap is real: slash-commands §7 step 8 needs the RightButton half, and MultiMeters' 'Disabled 8' drives only LeftButton. The necessity lens wanted this routed to the LibKa0s kit, but that is wrong. The conformance suite is per-addon, the menu mock is addon-local (tests/mock_menu.lua), and the other 10 addons already drive RightButton in tests/test_disabled.lua. MultiMeters is the outlier, so the fix is the small local patch.
verdicts.remediation: Extend 'Disabled 8' in tests/test_disabled.lua to drive OnClick(obj,'RightButton') through the addon-local tests/mock_menu.lua (reuse or lift the openMenu helper from test_launchersetup.lua:264, or copy the KickCD pattern). Assert that Enabled is clickable, the other entries are grayed, there are zero __svWrites() and zero frame shows. Add the falsification comment (testing-§12) and regenerate docs/test-cases.md and the README badge if the count changes.

verdicts.assessment: Both copies defer to Secrets.CanAccess, so nothing is wrong at runtime and the invariant is broken only in letter. The copies have drifted a little. It is cheap tidying while MM-R-01 already has Aggregator.lua open.
verdicts.remediation: Add Secrets.PlainTruth to core/Secrets.lua, replace the local copies in Aggregator.lua:446 and Tooltip.lua:224 (and the seam re-exports used by Aggregator_Identity/Tooltip_Lines), and add a test in tests/test_secrets.lua.
